scope: Sponsored budget and purchase journal against immutable report inputs, with uncertain-settlement recovery
verified: An unfunded budget refuses before any provider is asked, writing no purchase and reserving nothing

The ceiling is held in reserve until reconciliation, then replaced by the actual cost

A per-account daily allowance bounds one account without blocking another
